name: whaler_buried
notes: The Thankful, a whaler of the same build as `whaler` lost in 1849 and found in the sea cave under Hogback Island: the 32 m hull pitched 14 degrees bow-up and rolled 11 degrees to port, sunk to her waterline in a sand drift that is deepest at the stern and has filled her hold under the broken deckhouse, bowsprit pointing up out of the drift, masts broken off short and splintered, a topmast, a yard and the planks of a whaleboat lying on the sand. Bow to local -Z. Settles into the ground without levelling; carves nothing.
